description: Unique National Provider Identifier for each provider record.
Indicates whether the provider is an individual (1) or organization (2).
Legal business name for organization records.
Provider last name for individual records.
Provider first name for individual records.
Clinical credential or degree if provided.
Business practice location state abbreviation or code after cleaning.
Original business practice postal code from NPPES.
Primary listed taxonomy code from NPPES field set.
Indicator showing whether taxonomy_code_1 is marked primary.
Broad taxonomy group associated with taxonomy_code_1.
Date the NPI was originally enumerated.
Most recent NPPES update date for the provider record.
Date the NPI was deactivated, if applicable.
Date the NPI was reactivated after deactivation, if applicable.
Standardized 5 digit ZIP code derived from practice_zip for geography joins.
